resources.string: Nocturne reads sleep stages only when you enable the History overlay. If you separately enable programme export and grant write permission, it writes completed, receipt-confirmed BedJet programmes as sleep sessions labelled “BedJet programme ran”. This is not verified sleep. Equipment tests, demo, incomplete and uncertain nights are never exported. You can revoke either permission in Health Connect.

Start one chosen profile on the selected BedJet. Skip if a night is already running, the BedJet cannot be reached, or the plan changes. Selecting another BedJet pauses this setting; switch Auto-start off and on to link it to that BedJet.
No usable upcoming alarm start; using the profile fallback at %1$s. Phone alarms must be from an allowed source and 1–18 h after the planned start, with that start within the next 24 h.
Only if the phone is charging
When charging is required, a 60-second notification countdown lets you cancel before the attempt. Charging and the plan are checked again after the countdown.
The alarm uses the exact-alarm permission already held by Nocturne. Android still controls when the background job can run; an attempt more than 15 minutes late is skipped.
Android uses a 15-minute window. Power saving may delay delivery further; an attempt outside that window is skipped.
These settings changed or need a profile and a real BedJet. Review Auto-start and try again.
Unknown — check the BedJet before trying again. %1$s
The BedJet confirmed this programme before local bookkeeping was interrupted.
The automatic attempt was interrupted before this programme could be confirmed.
A night or another BedJet run is already active.
Bluetooth or notification access is unavailable.
The plan, alarm, selected BedJet or Auto-start settings changed, or this night was already attempted or cancelled.
Auto-start skipped: saved data could not be read.
Auto-start saved this programme’s wake at %1$s.
External integrations are unavailable in demo.

Optional, off by default. With your write permission, completed, receipt-confirmed nights are saved to Health Connect as “BedJet programme ran” — not verified sleep. Demo, equipment tests, interrupted and uncertain nights stay excluded. Turning this off stops new writes; existing Health Connect records remain there.
A completed BedJet programme was confirmed by the BedJet. These times describe programme activity, not verified sleep. No sleep stages were measured or inferred.
Health Connect write permission is required. Enable programme export again to review access, then sync.
No programme was exported in this pass. Sync now can retry completed, confirmed programmes without a current History marker.
Sync could not finish. Confirmed exports keep their History marker; unmarked or changed records can be retried with Sync now.
